Body.Content:
Business Value

Tap to Pay on Android empowers sales associates with mobility, enabling them to accept payments directly on over-the-counter Android devices without relying on fixed terminals. This reduces the need for costly payment hardware, streamlines checkout experiences, and enhances customer engagement by allowing transactions anywhere in the store.

Feature Details

This feature enables Tap to Pay on Android devices running the Store Commerce App via the Adyen payment connector. As a prerequisite, the Adyen payment app must be installed on each device. When a sales associate initiates Tap to Pay, Store Commerce seamlessly launches Adyen’s payment app to start the NFC payment experience, allowing customers to tap NFC-enabled cards or mobile wallets directly on the Android device. Upon completion, the authorized payment details are securely passed back to Store Commerce, which updates the transaction accordingly. This context handoff between Store Commerce and the Adyen app establishes an extensible pattern that can be leveraged for additional scenarios e.g., loading custom apps built on PowerApps.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
